name: Motorcycle
description: Any motor vehicle with a seat or saddle and no more than three wheels on the ground, other than an electric bicycle. An electric one is a full motorcycle rather than a motor-driven cycle when its motor produces more than 5 brake horsepower (3,750 W) or it weighs 200 lb or more.

restrictions.rule: A seat or saddle, and no more than three wheels on the ground
An electric one whose motor produces more than 5 brake horsepower (3,750 W), or that weighs 200 lb or more fully equipped, is a motorcycle rather than a motor-driven cycle
Riders need a Class M license or Class M on their driver's license, from a motorcycle knowledge test or an MSF Basic Rider Course, and must be 16 or older
Riders 17 and younger are held to the graduated license's operating hours and restrictions
Riders and passengers must wear a motorcycle helmet meeting Alabama's standard, and shoes
Titled, registered, and must carry a license tag to ride on public highways
Gets the full use of a lane, ridden no more than two abreast; no lane splitting or passing in the same lane
Carries a passenger only on a seat designed for one, and the rider sits astride facing forward
